parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a modern library or bookstore. The library has a high ceiling with multiple levels of bookshelves, each filled with books of different sizes and colors. The shelves are arranged in a circular pattern, creating a sense of depth and dimension. On the right side of the image, there is a large circular display of books, and on the left side, there are several orange armchairs and tables. In the center of the room, two people are sitting at a table, working on their laptops. The floor is made of marble, and there are a few people walking around the room. The overall atmosphere of the library is cozy and inviting.
